youtube._censor_comment: true = upload the profanity-censored copy (YouTube age-restricts/demonetizes over spoken language).

rumble._cdp_comment: Recommended: set cdp_url to attach to a Chrome window you're already logged into (e.g. 'http://localhost:9222') instead of storing your password and automating login - see README.md for the launch command. Leave null to fall back to RUMBLE_USERNAME/RUMBLE_PASSWORD in .env.
rumble._category_comment: Rumble REQUIRES a primary category - the submit button stays disabled without one. Must match the dropdown label exactly (e.g. Gaming, Entertainment).

rumble._dedup_comment: skip_if_exists: check the channel RSS feed + local history and skip videos already on Rumble. rss_url defaults to https://rumble.com/user/<channel>/index.xml.
rumble._censor_comment: false = upload the ORIGINAL uncensored audio to Rumble.

general._watch_folder_comment: Relative paths resolve next to this config file, so './watch_folder' = D:/AutoBleepPro-main/auto_uploader/watch_folder and keeps working if you re-extract the ZIP somewhere else. Set an absolute path (e.g. 'D:/videos stizz') to watch a different folder instead.
general._title_comment: filename_channel_prefixes strips a leading "<channel> - " from yt-dlp downloads, so "Stackswopo - LOL NO -YdH8jO6Vjs.mp4" becomes the title "LOL NO". --watch never prompts (nobody's at the keyboard); it falls back to default_title, or use a .txt sidecar.
general._censor_comment: Bleeps profanity before upload (reuses the AutoReel censoring engine) so YouTube doesn't age-restrict/demonetize over spoken language. censor_device: null = auto-detect GPU/CPU, or set 'cuda'/'cpu'. censor_bleep_method: 'silence' mutes flagged words, 'beep' overlays a tone.
general._cleanup_comment: Frees disk after each successful upload. The censored copy is a full re-encode (roughly the size of the source video) - that's what actually costs gigabytes; logs are kilobytes, so they're trimmed rather than deleted so failures stay diagnosable. source_video: 'move' keeps the original in uploaded/ (default), 'delete' frees it once BOTH platforms succeeded (the original is gone - only use this if the video exists elsewhere), 'keep' leaves it where it was. keep_uploaded_videos: 0 = off; set e.g. 3 to keep only the 3 newest in uploaded/.

features._comment: Optional extras. self_healing: python main.py --health. social_promoter posts AFTER a successful new upload (Discord needs DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL in .env; twitter/reddit need their API keys + pip install tweepy/praw). content_optimizer writes an SEO/chapters report next to each uploaded video, reusing the censor pass's transcript.
